scope: Numerical implementation, canonical arrays, tabular export, and independently derived analytical/numerical checks. Figure rendering and prose layout are handled by final artifact QA.

evidence: Python AST parsing and runtime imports passed. Repeated the complete approved 1D baseline with the current solver; no exception.
Audited boundary CSV has 241 finite rows at 0..14400 s in 60 s increments; Q1 only interpolates 0..1800 s.
Raw PDF, raw boundary XLSX, template XLSX and cleaned CSV hashes match data_profile.json; original files remain unchanged.
Constants, SI geometry, temperature and dry-basis moisture initial values match the Q1 method card.

2D finite-cylinder nodal FVM and 1D radial baseline implement conservative div(D grad C), true surface-node Robin fluxes, zero axis/midplane fluxes, and separate thermal/nonlinear-moisture solves for Q1.
Current-level Picard iterations converge against both increment and residual criteria; graded startup begins with two backward-Euler half steps, followed by nonlinear trapezoidal integration.
No unapproved latent heat, sorption, shrinkage, random algorithm, or model fallback was introduced.
The decision ledger contains q1_method_choice and explicit q1_midplane_output_confirmation; result scope is z=0.
Repeated q1_baseline_r16 in a temporary directory using refinement=16, dimension=1, dt=0.5 and graded startup; all arrays match exactly.
All 1800x21 temperature/moisture arrays, 7 snapshot arrays and balances exactly equal the saved baseline (maximum difference 0).
Python 3.10.9, NumPy 2.2.6 and SciPy 1.15.3 are recorded. Independent reference script reproduces geometry and analytical checks.
Canonical main and baseline arrays have 1800 times x 21 radii, finite values, compatible times/radii, and 7 saved 2D snapshots.
Both 7x5 paper tables and all canonical JSON cells exactly equal the corresponding main NPZ arrays rounded to four decimals.

Current workbook audit identifies source_run=q1_main_r16 and verifies 75600 numeric cells, zero difference from the canonical four-decimal JSON, 0.0000 format and B2 frozen panes; current workbook/JSON hashes independently match the audit.
Run summary and convergence metrics identify actual main/baseline methods, input/output paths, runtime, residuals, model assumptions and inactive fallback.
At the first radial node the physical operator coefficient is 4*a/dr^2; at the axial symmetry node it is 2*a/dz^2.
Scaled volume is 2.5e-5 m^3 and exterior area is 0.0027 m^2 (both omit common 2*pi); corner cells include both exposed faces.
Current canonical grid variable-D similarity-transformed operator is exactly symmetric; arbitrary-state integral balance residual is 1.4666e-21 in scaled concentration-volume units.
Main maximum normalized heat balance residual is 2.4056e-10 degC; moisture balance residual is 2.9280e-13 kg/kg.
Main nonlinear residual is at most 3.2860e-10 kg/kg, below the specified 2e-9 tolerance.
No clipping is used; every integration step checks physical bounds. Main C is within [0.8345773,2.55] and T within [28,38.914496] up to roundoff.
The 1D Bessel eigenfunction solution integrates the piecewise-linear measured ambient boundary analytically; 256-to-512-mode change is 1.5649e-8 degC.
Canonical q1_main_r16 z=0 temperature differs from this analytical reference by at most 2.1658e-6 degC over all 37800 outputs; its same-grid baseline differs by 2.1657e-6 degC.

A finite-cylinder Bessel/cosine product solution independently checks 2D boundaries: the current coarse-axial-grid full-field snapshot error is at most 0.0101358 degC; doubling axial reference modes changes the reference by 4.7755e-7 degC. Full-field values remain diagnostic.
Canonical q1_main_r16 versus q1_baseline_r16 differs at z=0 by at most 3.7395e-7 degC and 2.2140e-12 kg/kg.
Halving baseline time steps (q1_reference_r16) changes full outputs by at most 5.3520e-7 degC and 3.8791e-7 kg/kg.
Doubling radial resolution at dt=0.25 (q1_spacecheck_r32) changes outputs by at most 1.1324e-6 degC and 8.3835e-6 kg/kg.

Canonical main versus finer 1D reference combined differences are 1.6377e-6 degC and 8.4142e-6 kg/kg; these are convergence estimates, not observed prediction errors or a guarantee of each fourth decimal.

residual_risks: No internal experimental temperature/moisture observations exist; numerical agreement does not establish physical prediction accuracy.
C_eq=C_infinity and equal side/end coefficients are disclosed model assumptions. Latent heat and sorption closure are not supplied.

Official output accuracy is assessed at z=0. Full-domain endpoint fields remain diagnostic: the independently computed thermal snapshot maximum error is about 0.01014 degC with the current 25-node axial grid; four-decimal full-field accuracy is not claimed.
Nonlinear solve failure raises a descriptive error requiring a smaller-step rerun; automatic rejection/retry is not implemented or needed in these successful runs.
This review does not constitute human acceptance, numerical-claim freeze, or authorization to submit externally.
